raw_text: {"translation": "At any rate they are so simple-minded that even now someone who takes up these writings expects, first, that I should demonstrate in this discourse the things which anyone who intends to investigate anything about plethora [523] accurately must by all means know; and second, that I should discover the diagnosis and treatment of each kind of plethora — not recognising that, if matters so great were of such a nature as to be demonstrated through a single writing, the art would not be long. But I, for my part, have demonstrated in the books On the Doctrines of Hippocrates and Plato that the faculty in the arteries is something other than that in the nerves and veins.
